title: Sync algorithm
summary: Three-stage drift correction, leader selection, sync groups, offsets, and Live Edge Sync.

title: Persistence storage
summary: StorageAdapter fallback through chrome.storage, IndexedDB, localStorage, and URL parameters.

title: postMessage security
summary: Origin validation, command allowlist, argument sanitization, and event type filtering.

title: Audio master pinning
summary: Tile-specific audio focus across duplicate video IDs, sync recovery, lazy loading, deletion, and local restoration.

title: Playlist batch add
summary: Playlist URL detection, playlistItems API loading, and batch tile creation.

title: Search enhancements
summary: Search history, duration/order filters and batched result metadata work; channel-related search remains unimplemented (two of three feature groups delivered).

title: Timestamp extraction
summary: Extract timestamps from descriptions and seek on click.

title: Performance optimization
summary: IntersectionObserver loading, thumbnails, content-visibility, and unloaded tile sync skipping.

title: ES Module architecture
summary: Modular JavaScript structure with storage, state, player, sync, UI, and feature modules.

title: Playlist queue mode
summary: Single-tile queue playback with stable tile identity and queue round-trips through local storage, shared URL, JSON, and presets.

title: Channel live monitor
summary: Channel registration, live polling, auto-add, visibility handling, and quota management.

title: Layout fit relayout
summary: Safe relayout for fit mode after UI chrome changes.

title: Frameless drag stabilization
summary: Explicit drag handle and stable frameless-window behavior.

title: Sidebar and toolbar cleanup
summary: Stable sidebar, toolbar, immersive state, and recovery paths.

title: Fit Mode Controller
summary: Dynamic layout, Cover, Focus and Quick Fit controls; legacy Full-Fit was removed.

title: Video add UX
summary: History, channel pins, session restore, batch search add, and video-add UX improvements.

title: Sidebar UI redesign
summary: Unified input, accordion sidebar, compact bulk controls, and persistent section state.

title: Layout UX friction fixes
summary: Video-add relayout, resize tracking, single-column height, scroll/drag separation, and sticky toolbar.

title: UI/UX refinement Phase 1
summary: 10 of 11 UX items are implemented. F-04 implementation remains not started; local comparison previews cover two search layouts in five states, while layout and visual direction remain unselected.

title: Objective Dense Gallery Canvas
summary: Dense multi-view layout option for scanning 8-12 streams with objective candidate scoring, selected 3x4 proof, and opt-in committed review evidence that routine tests do not overwrite.

title: Real Multi-Live Playback Reliability Probe
summary: Probe has mocked and three-live packaged observations, including controlled app-network interruption/recovery and queue pointer repairs. Cross-port persistence is unresolved; natural failures and human acceptance remain unverified.

title: Personalized RSS Feed and Advanced Playback
summary: No-API-Key architecture using public YouTube RSS feeds, client-side profile scoring/filtering, right-side feed tray, multi-window popouts, URL transfer, and live reservation.
